title: Invoice-to-Cash and Credit Management Competitive Landscape

scope.description: POM and nine alternatives for institutional creditors' invoicing, payment and arrears-resolution jobs, with European emphasis.
inclusionLogic: Regional direct credit-management and billing suites: Onguard, CreditDevice and FIQAS.
Broader enterprise order-to-cash suites: Sidetrade, Billtrust and HighRadius.
Different operating choices: PAIR Finance as a service substitute, Mollie as a payment option and Exact as an ERP/accounting substitute.
Category labels describe qualitative reach, not measured market-share ranks. Descriptions distinguish the comparison role.
notes: Snapshot 2026-09-06. Official product and company sources support capabilities and locations; positioning is an analyst inference.
POM is the anchor, not one of its nine alternatives. Mail to Pay and Mind2Pay are group context, not independent competitors.
Unestablished business metrics are omitted. Empty businessStats means unknown, not zero.
Collected value, revenue, payment volume and customer counts are not interchangeable. Preserve POM Netherlands versus investor group scopes.
Vendor uplifts are not independent benchmarks. No pricing, share, engineering headcount or growth is inferred.
Billtrust's reviewed office page does not establish a unique headquarters; the uncertainty is retained.
Availability, packaging, contractual duties and integration depth require customer-specific verification.

players.name: POM
players.description: Reference company. Connects creditor invoicing, payment requests and collection workflows. The modeled architecture and teams are proposals.

businessStats.scope: POM group, investor-reported value collected; not revenue or one product's transaction volume
Investor-reported POM group; not comparable to the separate POM Netherlands customer count

players.name: Onguard
players.description: Direct alternative for multinational credit and collections teams: receivables visibility, configurable follow-up, disputes and related invoicing. Competitive relevance is inferred from workflow overlap, not a verified POM shortlist.

players.name: CreditDevice
players.description: Regional direct alternative combining credit information, receivables management and credit-insurance policy management. Its adjacent risk functions extend beyond the approved-receivable resolution boundary.

players.name: FIQAS / Abillity
players.description: Direct alternative combining recurring billing, payment processing, reconciliation and debtor follow-up. Broader rating and subscription functions precede this domain's approved-receivable starting point.

players.name: Sidetrade
players.description: Enterprise order-to-cash alternative covering invoicing, collections, disputes, cash application and buyer self-service with AI capabilities. Equivalence to POM's consumer or housing workflows is not assumed.

players.name: Billtrust
players.hq: United States; current official page lists Nashville and Hamilton Township without designating headquarters
players.description: Broad B2B receivables alternative with invoicing, payments, credit, collections and cash application. Its supplier orientation must be considered against institutional and consumer-facing collection uses.

players.name: HighRadius
players.description: Enterprise finance-automation alternative with collections, cash application, deductions and electronic invoicing. Broader accounts-payable and treasury products are outside this comparison.

players.name: PAIR Finance
players.description: Digital collection-service substitute for outsourcing receivable resolution. Its service and escalation responsibilities differ from creditor-operated invoicing and payment software.

players.name: Mollie
players.description: Adjacent payment option: links and branded checkout can satisfy a simple get-paid job. Payment access alone does not establish equivalent arrears policy, support arrangements or housing case management.

players.name: Exact
players.description: ERP/accounting substitute when native invoicing, reminders and payment links are sufficient. Tests whether specialist collection software earns its added integration and subscription cost.
